messages:
alaric: kicking off onboarding for opalica7b-int4 (canary). seeing sporadic OOMs on canaries with batch_size=8 and max_new_tokens=512. logs point at mem fragmentation + large KV prefetch spikes. attaching quick trace below.

maya: ack. any repro script or minimal request that triggers it? can we correlate with sequence length distribution?

alaric: short repro:  prompt ~1.2k tokens, then gen 400-600 tokens. pattern: cold starts run fine, after a few requests fragmentation grows and then OOMs. stack shows allocations in attention kernels + large KV buffer allocations. snippet from worker logs:
```
OOM: cudaMalloc failed at attention_kernel.cu:123
KV cache prefetch requested 1.1GB
fragmentation free-blocks: 24MB, 12MB, 6MB ...
```

jun: hunch: prefetch is allocating full session KV upfront for predicted max_gen (max_new_tokens). if many warm requests and no slot compaction, freelist can't coalesce. try: disable prefetch and cap max_new_tokens per route.

ciara: agree. Also can we try smaller microbatching? reduce batch_size to 4 and set max_new_tokens default to 256 for canary. if perf hit is small we keep it.

tara: I'll run two canaries: A) prefetch=false, batch_size=4, max_new_tokens=256; B) prefetch=true, batch_size=8, max_new_tokens=256 + force-slot-shrink after each request. will run 2000 requests spread over 1 hour.

sre-bot: deploy-job started: deploy/opalica7b-canary-6419012345 (params attached). ETA ~25m :hourglass:

maya: also try kernel-affinity tweak: set THREAD_AFFINITY=high for attention kernels on GPU to avoid fragmentation from concurrent small allocs.

tara: quick update: A is stable after 800 requests, memory steady. B hit OOM at ~420 requests but different pattern; slot-shrink helped momentarily but fragmentation returned.

jun: suggests automation: add route-level guard that overrides client max_new_tokens to 256 if model==opalica7b-int4 and batch_size>=8. low lift and prevents users from shooting themselves.

alaric: good idea. I'll patch model catalog defaults and add a note in onboarding doc. action items:
- tara: run extended 6h canary A and validate quality/regression vs fp16 baseline (QA harness) (assigned tara)
- jun: push quick route-override PR to gate max_new_tokens for canary (assigned jun)
- ciara: add a short runbook entry: prefetch knob, slot-shrink command, and detection alert (assigned ciara)

ciara: runbook draft link: https://redwood-internal.local/runbooks/opalica7b-prefetch (will fill after validation)

alaric: thanks team. if A passes quality + latency, we'll set canary defaults to batch_size=4, max_new_tokens=256 and keep prefetch off for now. will follow up with final postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
